name: financecheck-ai-naail
description: Educational finance with source-graded SEC XBRL verification workflow, clear evidence caveats and deterministic accounting tests. Public filing retrieval is optional local backend only and not connected to ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Learn financial statements and accounting with transparent arithmetic, source-graded SEC XBRL workflow instructions, fictional examples and concise story cards. A local reference module can evaluate extracted SEC public facts when separately connected and explicitly enabled; this plugin has NO LIVE SEC/ERP/BANK/market-data connection and has NOT authenticated company reports here. No audit assurance, investment advice or confidential uploads.
defaultPrompt: Explain why profit differs from cash flow using fictional figures.
Help verify a public company annual revenue claim: distinguish inspected SEC facts from my submitted numbers.
Show a three-card explanation of revenue growth and what was not independently checked.

publication.release_notes: V3.2 adds source-graded SEC XBRL review skills, a disabled-by-default local SEC reference tool, benchmark/evidence protocol and independent regression tests. No live MCP server is connected.
